newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso ends weaker in range-bound trade.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso ends weaker in range-bound trade.

text.p: * Central Bank keeps peso from falling beyond 26.375
The Philippine peso ended slightly weaker at 26.375 to the dollar as some banks tried to cover their short-selling earlier in the day, traders said.
The peso was hovering between 26.370 to 26.372 at the opening, but slowly depreciated to 26.375 hitting the Central Bank's selling rate by late trade.
"There's nothing to move the peso either way," a trader from a foreign bank said.
The Central Bank sold about $20 million at 26.375 to keep the peso from sliding further, he said.
Total turnover reached $194.20 million as against $164.5 million on Tuesday.
Traders said they expected the peso to remain at current levels in the coming days.
